name: floodroute-ai
description: AI-Powered Flood-Aware Route Planning, Weather Intelligence, Community Reporting and Emergency Alert Platform for India

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,WEB,ADMIN,AI" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/admin" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/ai-service --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,WEB,ADMIN,AI" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@floodroute/admin" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/ai-service --port 8000 --reload"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/shared && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/server && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/web && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/admin
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/shared && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/web
scripts.build:admin: npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/shared && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/admin
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/shared && npm run build --workspace=@floodroute/server
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --project packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/admin/tsconfig.json
